anthropic.name: compress
anthropic.description: Replace consumed conversation ranges with self-contained summaries using mNNNNN or bN refs; batch multiple ranges into ONE call (a single string may hold every range). Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool. Context management is provided by billion-context — report billion-context problems at github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/issues.

content.description: ONE JSON-escaped string holding ALL ranges — one block per range, first line 'm00150–m00220 optional topic', remaining lines the summary markdown.

anthropic.name: decompress
anthropic.description: Restore compressed content by block id (b5) or message ref; block mode writes to a file by default, inline: true returns small content inline. Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool.

toFile.description: Optional: write content to file instead of context

full.description: Restore all the way to original messages

imageRef.description: Optional mNNNNN message ref whose IMAGE payload you want restored (an image that was stripped or folded away). Pass "list" to enumerate every image currently restorable. Restored images are written to host-readable files and their paths returned — open them with the read tool. Independent of blockId/range and of CCR.

anthropic.name: search_context
anthropic.description: Search compressed summaries and historical messages by keyword; returns refs, sizes, previews. Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool.

anthropic.name: acp_status
anthropic.description: Context usage overview, compressible ranges, block drilldown. Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool.

scope.description: "uncompressed": history outside active blocks; "compressed": block ledger; omit = default overview

view.description: "messages" for a per-message listing; "ranges" is the default

tool.description: With view:"messages": only list results of this tool name

archiveDetail.description: List pre-compaction archived blocks per-id instead of grouped by reason

anthropic.name: acp_cache
anthropic.description: Prompt-cache reconciliation: grand ledger (total input/cached/output, overall hit rate) with every request's miss split into new content / compression re-pay / upstream-ttl-or-client-rewrite (unattributed stable-prefix misses), plus per-fold economics (breakeven turns vs measured cadence). Defaults to a compact summary (totals + verdicts + anomalies only); pass detail="full" for every fold and its line-item breakdown. Read-only. Call when asked about cache hits, cache invalidation, or what compression costs. Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool.

detail.description: "summary" (default): totals, verdicts, notable folds, anomalous requests only. "full": every retained fold and its line-item breakdown (most-recent window — the output states the cap).

anthropic.name: acp_read_original_image
anthropic.description: Read the ORIGINAL full-resolution image of a message whose picture was downscaled before reaching you. Beside each shrunken image there is a [bili] note quoting its mNNNNN ref and both sizes — pass that ref here. The original bytes are returned as an image attached to this result. The original can be much larger than the downscaled copy, so call this only when you actually need full-resolution detail (small text, colors, pixel alignment); the downscaled version is enough for most work.

ref.description: The mNNNNN message ref quoted in the [bili] downsample note beside the shrunken image.
